headline: Muscat Stock Exchange Listed Banks Report 8.1% Profit Increase
summary: Net profits for banks listed on the Muscat Stock Exchange rose to OMR 455 million in the first nine months of the year, representing an 8.1% year-on-year increase.
why: Banking sector profitability serves as a core indicator of economic health and credit demand within Oman's financial system.

impacts.name: Banking
impacts.why: Higher net profits reflect stable lending margins and sustained credit growth across commercial lenders.
